exact_error: GNU timeout returned exit status 124 after 1200 seconds. The Codex CLI emitted no JSONL thread, model, command, usage, error, or final-result event.
root_cause_evidence: Both attempts used a PTY, wrote the prompt and one Ctrl-D in the same nonempty canonical-input write, then emitted zero Codex events. In terminal canonical mode that Ctrl-D makes buffered input readable but does not necessarily provide a subsequent empty-read EOF, so the CLI can remain waiting for end-of-input. This is the best-supported controller-side cause; no model execution or service failure was confirmed.
correction_to_attempt_1_interpretation: Attempt 1 also emitted zero Codex events under the same one-write PTY pattern. Its requested model and routing remain recorded, but actual model execution was not confirmed. Neither timeout is evidence of model unavailability and neither permits a model fallback.
next_attempt_control: Attempt 3 must not use an interactive TTY. Feed a committed prompt file through ordinary non-interactive stdin redirection so EOF is deterministic, retain the external 1200-second timeout, and require the first JSONL thread event as proof that model execution began.
